title: Utility Types
description: TypeScript'ning tayyor tip o'zgartiruvchilari: Partial, Required, Readonly, Pick, Omit, Record, Exclude, Extract, ReturnType va boshqalar.

topics.title: Partial, Required, Readonly
topics.summary: Barcha xossalarni ixtiyoriy, majburiy yoki o'zgarmas qilish

blocks.text: **Utility tiplar** — TypeScript bilan birga keladigan tayyor generic tiplar. Ular mavjud tipdan yangi tip yasaydi va takroriy tip e'lonlaridan qutqaradi. Bir marta `User` yozib, undan o'nlab variant hosil qilish mumkin.

rows: Barcha xossalarni **majburiy** qiladi (`?` ni olib tashlaydi)

blocks.text: Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan holat — obyektni **qisman yangilash** funksiyasi. Foydalanuvchi faqat o'zgartirmoqchi bo'lgan maydonlarni beradi: `updateUser(id, { email: "yangi@mail.uz" })`.
Tashqaridan ixtiyoriy sozlamalar qabul qilinib, ichkarida default qiymatlar bilan to'ldirilgach, natija `Required<Options>` bo'ladi — endi hech bir maydon `undefined` emasligi kafolatlangan.
Funksiyaga berilgan obyektni u o'zgartirmasligini kafolatlash yoki holatni (state) faqat yangi obyekt yaratish orqali yangilashni majburlash uchun.
`Readonly<T>` **sayoz** (shallow) ishlaydi: ichki obyektlar o'zgaruvchan bo'lib qoladi. Chuqur o'zgarmaslik uchun o'z `DeepReadonly<T>` tipingizni yozish kerak ("Ilg'or tiplar" bo'limiga qarang).

topics.title: Pick, Omit, Record
topics.summary: Xossalarni tanlash, chiqarib tashlash va lug'at tipi

blocks.text: Pick va Omit — qachon qaysi biri?

items: Katta tipdan **bir nechta** xossa kerak bo'lsa — `Pick` (ro'yxat qisqa bo'ladi).
Katta tipdan **deyarli hammasi** kerak, bir-ikkitasi ortiqcha bo'lsa — `Omit`.
Klassik holat: bazadagi `User` dan `password` ni olib tashlab, API javobi tipini yasash — `Omit<User, "password">`.
Yangi obyekt yaratish formasi uchun: `Omit<Product, "id" | "createdAt">` — bu maydonlarni server o'zi beradi.

blocks.text: `Record<K, V>` — kalitlari `K` tipida, qiymatlari `V` tipida bo'lgan obyekt. `K` literal union bo'lsa, **barcha** kalitlar bo'lishi shart — bu hech bir holat tushib qolmasligini kafolatlaydi.
Utility'larni birlashtirish mumkin: `Partial<Pick<User, "name" | "email">>` — faqat ism va emailni, ixtiyoriy tarzda.

examples.title: Omit bilan maxfiy maydonlarni yashirish
examples.code:
type DbUser = {
    id: number
    username: string
    email: string
    passwordHash: string
    salt: string
    lastLogin: string
}

type SafeUser = Omit<DbUser, "passwordHash" | "salt">

function toSafeUser(user: DbUser): SafeUser {
    const { passwordHash, salt, ...safe } = user
    return safe
}

const dbUser: DbUser = {
    id: 1,
    username: "ali",
    email: "ali@mail.uz",
    passwordHash: "hash123",
    salt: "salt456",
    lastLogin: "2026-09-22",
}

console.log(toSafeUser(dbUser))
console.log("Maxfiy maydonlar yo'q:", !("passwordHash" in toSafeUser(dbUser)))
examples.output:
{
  id: 1,
  username: 'ali',
  email: 'ali@mail.uz',
  lastLogin: '2026-09-22'
}
Maxfiy maydonlar yo'q: true

examples.title: Record bilan guruhlash natijasi
examples.code:
type Category = "texnika" | "kiyim" | "oziq-ovqat"

const items: { name: string; category: Category; price: number }[] = [
    { name: "Noutbuk", category: "texnika", price: 9_000_000 },
    { name: "Ko'ylak", category: "kiyim", price: 250_000 },
    { name: "Non", category: "oziq-ovqat", price: 4_000 },
    { name: "Telefon", category: "texnika", price: 4_500_000 },
]

const grouped = items.reduce((acc, item) => {
    ;(acc[item.category] ??= []).push(item.name)
    return acc
}, {} as Record<Category, string[]>)

console.log(grouped)

const totals = {} as Record<Category, number>
for (const item of items) {
    totals[item.category] = (totals[item.category] ?? 0) + item.price
}
console.log(totals)

blocks.text: Bu utility'lar obyektlar bilan emas, **union tiplar** bilan ishlaydi — ulardan ayrim a'zolarni olib tashlaydi yoki tanlab oladi.

rows: `T` dan `U` ga mos a'zolarni olib tashlaydi
`T` dan faqat `U` ga mos a'zolarni oladi

blocks.text: Farqni eslab qolish: `Omit` / `Pick` — obyekt **kalitlari** bilan, `Exclude` / `Extract` — union **a'zolari** bilan ishlaydi.

examples.title: Union'dan funksiya tiplarini ajratib olish
examples.code:
type Mixed = string | number | (() => void) | ((a: number) => string) | null

type OnlyFunctions = Extract<Mixed, Function>
type OnlyPrimitives = Exclude<Mixed, Function | null>

const fn: OnlyFunctions = () => {}
const prim: OnlyPrimitives = "matn"

console.log(typeof fn, typeof prim)

const values: Mixed[] = ["a", 1, () => {}, null]
const functions = values.filter((v): v is OnlyFunctions => typeof v === "function")
console.log("Funksiyalar soni:", functions.length)

topics.summary: Funksiya va Promise tiplaridan tip olish

blocks.text: Bu utility'lar mavjud **funksiya** yoki **Promise** tipidan qism tiplarni ajratib oladi. Ayniqsa tashqi kutubxona funksiyasi tiplari eksport qilinmagan bo'lsa juda foydali.

rows: Promise ichidagi qiymat tipi (ichma-ich Promise'larni ham ochadi)

blocks.text: Diqqat: bu utility'lar **tip** qabul qiladi, qiymat emas. Funksiyadan tipini olish uchun `typeof` ishlatiladi: `ReturnType<typeof createUser>`.

"Tipni bir marta e'lon qil" tamoyili: funksiya natijasi uchun alohida interfeys yozish o'rniga `type User = ReturnType<typeof createUser>` qilsangiz, funksiya o'zgarganda tip ham avtomatik yangilanadi.

examples.title: ConstructorParameters
InstanceType
Parameters bilan wrapper — log
ReturnType bilan reducer
ThisParameterType
OmitThisParameter
ReturnType generic bilan
Parameters bilan hodisa handler'lari
Awaited bilan Promise.all
examples.code:
const [u, posts] = await Promise.all([Promise.resolve({ name: "Ali" }), Promise.resolve([1, 2, 3])])
type Res = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof Promise.all<[Promise<string>, Promise<number>]>>>
const sample: Res = ["a", 1]
console.log(u.name, posts.length, sample)

examples.title: ReturnType bilan async funksiya
Parameters ichidagi optional
examples.code:
function paginate(page: number, size?: number) { return `sahifa ${page}, hajm ${size ?? 20}` }
type PArgs = Parameters<typeof paginate>
const a1: PArgs = [1], a2: PArgs = [2, 50]
console.log(paginate(...a1), "/", paginate(...a2))

examples.title: Funksiya tipidan yangi funksiya tipi
examples.code:
type AsyncVersion<F extends (...a: any[]) => any> = (...a: Parameters<F>) => Promise<ReturnType<F>>
const square = (n: number) => n * n
const squareAsync: AsyncVersion<typeof square> = async n => square(n)
console.log(await squareAsync(9))

examples.title: Parameters rest bilan
examples.code:
function joinAll(sep: string, ...parts: string[]) { return parts.join(sep) }
type J = Parameters<typeof joinAll>
const j: J = ["-", "a", "b", "c"]
console.log(joinAll(...j))

examples.title: InstanceType abstrakt bo'lmagan klass
ReturnType overload'li funksiyada
examples.code:
function conv(x: string): number
function conv(x: number): string
function conv(x: string | number): string | number { return typeof x === "string" ? +x : String(x) }
type RC = ReturnType<typeof conv>
const rc: RC = "oxirgi imzo: string"
console.log(rc)
